_comment: Cross-runtime vectors for sealed blob framing. Read by BOTH src/__tests__/sealed-blob.test.ts and android/.../SealedBlobTest.kt, so the hand-authored Kotlin twin cannot drift from src/shared/sealed-blob.ts. The AAD binds the blob id, the chunk index and the final flag; a single character of difference means nothing decrypts, and a test inside one runtime cannot catch that because both its halves would share the mistake.
